```python
RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^## (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\s*(\\(.*\\))?\s*$")
```

`RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\#\# (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\s*(\\(.*\\))?\s*$")` (Wait, the read output shows `r\"^## (\\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\\s*(\\(.*\\))?\\s*$\"` which is Python string representation of the regex).

`RELEASE_HEADER_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\#\# (\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\s*(\\(.*\\))?\s*$")` (I am interpreting the raw string representation from the output).

Let's use the robust pattern: `r"^## ([\d\.]+)(?:\s*\((.*)\))?$"`.
